title: Deck drop: The Strategist (INTJ), four ways
caption:
Same type, four different engines.

The Strategist (INTJ) is three moves ahead of the room. But an Air INTJ plans your birthday and makes it look spontaneous, while an Earth INTJ has been quietly thinking about this since 2019. Your type is how you think. Your element is how you run.

Tag the INTJ in your life and ask which one they are.
